## FCAT Codebase Analysis

### 1. Overall Project Structure

```

  docs/

  FCAT/                          # Main (and only) project

    ViewModels/                  # 18 ViewModel files
    Views/                       # 9 View pairs (.xaml + .xaml.cs)
    App.xaml / App.xaml.cs       # WPF Application root
    Program.cs                   # Custom entry point (Velopack hook)
    MainWindow.xaml / .cs        # Shell window
    AlertOverlayWindow.xaml / .cs # Floating alert overlay
    Converters.cs                # WPF value converters (12 converters)
    AssemblyInfo.cs              # Theme info assembly attribute
    AppSecrets.example.cs        # Template for EVE API credentials
    FCAT.csproj                  # Project file
    fcat.ico                     # Application icon
  FCAT.slnx                     # Solution file (single project)
  README.md                     # Comprehensive project documentation
  RELEASING.md                  # Release process documentation
  LICENSE                       # MIT License
  .gitignore                    # Ignores secrets, build output, IDE files
```

### 2. What the Project Does

FCAT (Fleet Commander Assistance Tool) is a **Windows desktop companion application for EVE Online** fleet commanders. It provides:

- **Live fleet readout**: Polls the EVE ESI API every 5 seconds for fleet hierarchy, ship types, and systems
- **Ship-role classification**: Auto-classifies every pilot by hull into roles (Logi, DPS, Tackle, EWAR, Booster, etc.)
- **Boost tracking**: Reads the in-game boost chat channel to track which command-burst charges each booster is running
- **Combat alerts**: Watches the local combat log for tackle (warp scramble/disruption), cap-out events, booster deaths, logi chain breaks, and DPS attrition
- **D-scan analyzer**: Paste a directional scan or Local member list for instant threat breakdown by role
- **Constellation map**: Live map with real EVE positions, sovereignty coloring, kills/jumps, and Dotlan/zKillboard links
- **Intel feed**: Combined live feed from zKillboard kills and in-game intel chat channels
- **Ping/MOTD builder**: Compose fleet pings and push formatted MOTDs to the fleet via ESI
- **Form-up straggler tracking**: Monitors who has and hasn't arrived at staging
- **Cap-chain advisory**: Tracks Guardian/Basilisk cap-chain logi ring membership
- **After-action report**: Timeline of all fleet events (alerts, joins/leaves, deaths) exportable as Markdown
- **Battle report**: ISK destroyed vs lost, efficiency, kill/loss lists from zKillboard
- **Multi-character account management**: Add multiple characters (main + alts) with live status polling
- **Demo/sandbox mode**: Synthetic fleet for exercising all features offline
- **Auto-update**: In-app update via Velopack from GitHub Releases

### 3. Tech Stack

| Component | Technology |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Language** | C# (latest features: primary constructors, file-scoped namespaces, collection expressions) |
| **Runtime** | .NET 10 (`net10.0-windows`) |
| **UI Framework** | WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation) |
| **Architecture** | MVVM via CommunityToolkit.Mvvm v8.4.2 |
| **HTTP** | Microsoft.Extensions.Http v10.0.9 + raw HttpClient |
| **Auto-update** | Velopack v1.2.0 (GitHub Releases as the update source) |
| **Authentication** | EVE SSO (OAuth2) with PKCE, local HTTP listener on port 7648 |
| **Data persistence** | Settings: `%APPDATA%\FCAT\settings.json` (JSON). Characters: `%APPDATA%\FCAT\characters.dat` (DPAPI-encrypted) |
| **API integrations** | EVE ESI REST API, zKillboard API |
| **Local data** | EVE Gamelogs (combat log) and Chatlogs (boost/intel channels) parsed via FileSystemWatcher + polling |
| **Sound** | Procedurally synthesized WAV files (System.Media.SoundPlayer) |
| **Packaging** | Velopack CLI (`vpk pack`) producing Setup.exe installer |

**NuGet packages** (from `FCAT.csproj`):
- `CommunityToolkit.Mvvm` 8.4.2 -- source generators for `[ObservableProperty]`, `[RelayCommand]`
- `Microsoft.Extensions.Http` 10.0.9
- `Velopack` 1.2.0

### 4. Current State of Testing

**There are zero test files, zero test projects, and zero test configuration in this codebase.**

- No `*.Tests` project or directory exists
- No test framework references (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest)
- No test runner configuration
- No `.runsettings` file
- The solution (`FCAT.slnx`) contains only one project: `FCAT/FCAT.csproj`
- No mocking libraries (Moq, NSubstitute, etc.) are referenced
- No integration test infrastructure

The codebase is entirely untested by automated tests.

### 5. Main Source Code Organization

The project follows a clean **MVVM** (Model-View-ViewModel) pattern:

**Models** (`FCAT/Models/`, 10 files) -- Plain data classes, enums, and ESI DTOs:
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\AppSettings.cs` -- User settings persisted to disk
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\BoostAlert.cs` -- Alert types (Tackled, CapTrouble, BoostLost, LogiChain, DpsLoss) and `FcAlert` model
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\BoostCharge.cs` -- Boost category enum, charge catalog (15 charges across 7 categories), charge matching
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\EsiToken.cs` -- OAuth token model
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\FleetModels.cs` -- Extensive ESI DTOs: fleet info, members, wings, squads, character info, corp/alliance info, universe data (systems, stargates, constellations), killmails, zKillboard models, server status
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\InitProfileSeed.cs` -- Hard-coded INIT alliance seed data (boost/logi channel links, comms, doctrines)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\IntelEntry.cs` -- Intel feed entry model (kill or report)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\PingProfile.cs` -- Ping/MOTD profile with doctrines, channel links
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\ShipRole.cs` -- Ship role enum (14 roles) + `ShipRoleClassifier` with ESI group-id and type-id mappings
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Models\StoredCharacter.cs` -- Persisted authorized character

**Services** (`FCAT/Services/`, 17 files) -- Business logic, external integrations, file I/O:
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\AlertHub.cs` -- App-lifetime alert feed + overlay state, sound playback, auto-clear
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\BattleReportService.cs` -- Builds battle reports from zKillboard grouped fights
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\BoostChannelService.cs` -- Tails EVE Chatlogs for boost-channel posts, tracks per-pilot charge loadouts
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\CharacterStore.cs` -- DPAPI-encrypted character persistence
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\CombatLogService.cs` -- Tails EVE Gamelogs, raises tackle/cap-out alerts
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\DemoData.cs` -- Synthetic fleet data for demo/sandbox mode
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\EsiAuthService.cs` -- EVE SSO OAuth2 flow, multi-character token management, JWT parsing
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\EsiService.cs` -- ESI REST API client (40+ endpoints: fleet CRUD, universe, location, killmails)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\IntelChannelService.cs` -- Tails intel chat channel logs, region-filtered
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\MotdParser.cs` -- Extracts clickable channel links from fleet MOTDs
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\SessionLog.cs` -- After-action report timeline + battle report anchors + Markdown export
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\SettingsService.cs` -- JSON settings load/save to %APPDATA%
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\SoundService.cs` -- Procedural WAV synthesis + throttled playback
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\SystemSearchService.cs` -- Offline system name autocomplete with ESI-built index
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\ThemeService.cs` -- Live color theming (4 themes: Nebula, Carbon, Photon, Rust)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\UpdaterService.cs` -- Velopack auto-update against GitHub Releases
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\WormholeMass.cs` -- Fleet mass vs wormhole capacity checks
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\Services\ZkillService.cs` -- zKillboard API client (system kills + battle grouping)

**ViewModels** (`FCAT/ViewModels/`, 18 files):
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\ShellViewModel.cs` -- Application shell: navigation, session management, demo mode, auto-update
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\LoginViewModel.cs` -- SSO login
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\MenuViewModel.cs` -- Dashboard/command center (fleet preview, readiness, threat, alts, alerts)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\FleetViewModel.cs` -- Core fleet monitoring (1092 lines): polling, hierarchy, composition stats, boost coverage, advisories, cap chain, straggler tracking, DPS attrition, death detection, roster diff, fleet management (kick/move/invite/rename/create/delete)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\FleetMemberViewModel.cs` -- Single fleet member row with role badge, boost loadout
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\FleetStat.cs` -- Composition chips, boost stats, fleet advisories
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\WingViewModel.cs` / `SquadViewModel.cs` -- Fleet hierarchy nodes
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\IntelViewModel.cs` -- Intel tools container (scan + system + feed)
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\DScanViewModel.cs` -- D-scan analyzer + Local analyzer
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\SystemIntelViewModel.cs` -- Constellation map, system intel, hot systems
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\IntelFeedViewModel.cs` -- Combined kill/intel live feed
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\PingViewModel.cs` -- Ping/MOTD builder with alliance profiles
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\AlertsViewModel.cs` -- Session alert feed page
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\SettingsViewModel.cs` -- Settings page with scope health check
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\SessionLogViewModel.cs` -- After-action report with battle report
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\AccountViewModel.cs` -- Multi-character account manager with live polling
- `D:\code\FCAT\FCAT\ViewModels\MoveTargetViewModel.cs` -- Fleet move-target picker

**Views** (`FCAT/Views/`, 9 views as .xaml + .xaml.cs pairs):
- AccountView, AlertsView, FleetView, IntelView, LoginView, MenuView, PingView, SettingsView, SessionLogView

**Additional root-level files**:
- `App.xaml` -- Full design system: palette (brushes, colors), typography tokens, 10+ button/control styles, ComboBox/ScrollBar restyling, ViewModel-to-View DataTemplate mappings
- `Converters.cs` -- 12 WPF value converters (visibility, role colors, nav state, image loading with cache)
- `MainWindow.xaml` / `.xaml.cs` -- Shell chrome (nav rail, top bar, content area)
- `AlertOverlayWindow.xaml` / `.xaml.cs` -- Topmost, click-through floating overlay

### 6. CI/CD Configuration

There is **one GitHub Actions workflow**:

`D:\code\FCAT\.github\workflows\discord-release.yml`

This workflow posts release changelogs to a Discord channel whenever a GitHub Release is published. It uses the `SethCohen/github-releases-to-discord@v1` action with a Discord webhook secret.

There is **no build CI, no test CI, no deployment pipeline**. Releases are built and published manually using the `scripts/pack.ps1` PowerShell script + optional `vpk upload github` command, as documented in `RELEASING.md`.

### 7. Development Scripts and Tooling

- `D:\code\FCAT\scripts\pack.ps1` -- PowerShell script that:
  1. Runs `dotnet publish` for a self-contained win-x64 build
  2. Optionally downloads the previous release for delta generation (`-Delta` switch)
  3. Runs `vpk pack` to produce Setup.exe + release assets
  4. Outputs everything to `.\Releases\`

- **Build command**: `dotnet run --project FCAT/FCAT.csproj`
- **Publish command**: `dotnet publish FCAT/FCAT.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true`
- **Prerequisites**: .NET 10 SDK with Windows desktop workload, `vpk` CLI tool (`dotnet tool install -g vpk`)
- **No `Makefile`, `build.ps1`, or task runner** beyond the pack script

### 8. Architecture -- How Components Interact

**Dependency graph** (constructed manually, since there is no DI container):

```
Program.cs
  --> VelopackApp.Build().Run()    (installer/update hooks)
  --> App (WPF Application)

App.OnStartup():
  HttpClient (15s timeout)
  CharacterStore (DPAPI-encrypted disk store)
  EsiAuthService(HttpClient, CharacterStore) -- EVE SSO OAuth2
  EsiService(HttpClient, EsiAuthService)     -- ESI REST client
  CombatLogService()                         -- gamelog tail
  SettingsService()                          -- JSON settings
  ThemeService.Apply(...)                    -- paint saved theme
  SessionLog()                               -- AAR timeline
  AlertHub(SettingsService, SessionLog)       -- alert feed + overlay
  SystemSearchService(EsiService)            -- system autocomplete
  ZkillService(HttpClient)                   -- zKillboard client
  BattleReportService(ZkillService, EsiService)
  UpdaterService()                           -- Velopack auto-update

  ShellViewModel(all of the above)           -- root ViewModel
  MainWindow(AlertHub) { DataContext = ShellViewModel }
```

**Data flow**:

1. **EVE SSO login** --> `EsiAuthService` obtains OAuth tokens --> `CharacterStore` persists refresh tokens (DPAPI-encrypted)
2. **Fleet monitoring** --> `FleetViewModel` polls `EsiService.GetFleetMembersAsync` every 5 seconds --> resolves names/groups/types --> `ShipRoleClassifier.Classify()` assigns roles --> rebuilds hierarchy into `WingViewModel`/`SquadViewModel`/`FleetMemberViewModel`
3. **Combat alerts** --> `CombatLogService` tails EVE gamelog via FileSystemWatcher + StreamReader --> regex matches tackle/cap-out --> fires `AlertRaised` event --> `FleetViewModel` forwards to `AlertHub.Raise()` --> sound + overlay + AAR
4. **Boost tracking** --> `BoostChannelService` tails EVE Chatlogs (polled each fleet tick) --> matches charge names against `BoostChargeCatalog` --> attaches loadouts to fleet member rows
5. **Death detection** --> FleetViewModel compares per-pilot `ShipTypeId` group to Capsule group across ticks --> detects ship-to-pod transitions --> raises BoostLost/LogiChain/DpsLoss alerts, logs to AAR
6. **Intel feed** --> `IntelFeedViewModel` combines `ZkillService` kills + `IntelChannelService` chat log tailing --> `SystemSearchService` detects system names in intel reports
7. **Navigation** --> `ShellViewModel` owns `CurrentPage` (an `ObservableObject`) --> `App.xaml` DataTemplates map ViewModel types to View controls --> nav-rail commands swap `CurrentPage`
8. **Theming** --> `ThemeService.Apply()` replaces `DynamicResource` brush/color entries in `Application.Resources` --> all bindings re-resolve instantly
9. **Settings** --> `SettingsService` reads/writes `%APPDATA%\FCAT\settings.json` --> `AppSettings` model holds EVE logs path, boost/intel channel prefixes, form-up system, alert sounds, overlay state, theme, ping profiles
10. **Auto-update** --> `UpdaterService` wraps Velopack `UpdateManager` --> checks GitHub Releases on launch --> downloads in background --> offers restart pill in the top bar

**Key architectural properties**:
- No dependency injection container; all services are manually wired in `App.OnStartup()`
- Services are plain classes (no interfaces); direct concrete references throughout
- The `FleetViewModel` is the largest file at 1092 lines and contains the core fleet-monitoring logic
- The fleet session survives page navigation (kept alive on `ShellViewModel._session`) so alerts/overlay continue while browsing other pages
- The `AlertHub` lives for the entire app lifetime, not per-page
- Demo mode is a flag on `EsiService.DemoMode` that makes fleet-related calls return `DemoData` synthetic data
- Version: `0.14.0-beta` (current)
- Repository: `https://github.com/MifuneSG/FCAT`

### 6. CI/CD Configuration

There is **one GitHub Actions workflow**:

`D:\code\FCAT\.github\workflows\discord-release.yml`

This workflow posts release changelogs to a Discord channel whenever a GitHub Release is published. It uses the `SethCohen/github-releases-to-discord@v1` action with a Discord webhook secret.

There is **no build CI, no test CI, no deployment pipeline**. Releases are built and published manually using the `scripts/pack.ps1` PowerShell script + optional `vpk upload github` command, as documented in `RELEASING.md`.

### 7. Development Scripts and Tooling

- `D:\code\FCAT\scripts\pack.ps1` -- PowerShell script that:
  1. Runs `dotnet publish` for a self-contained win-x64 build
  2. Optionally downloads the previous release for delta generation (`-Delta` switch)
  3. Runs `vpk pack` to produce Setup.exe + release assets
  4. Outputs everything to `.\Releases\`

- **Build command**: `dotnet run --project FCAT/FCAT.csproj`
- **Publish command**: `dotnet publish FCAT/FCAT.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true`
- **Prerequisites**: .NET 10 SDK with Windows desktop workload, `vpk` CLI tool (`dotnet tool install -g vpk`)
- **No `Makefile`, `build.ps1`, or task runner** beyond the pack script

### 8. Architecture -- How Components Interact

**Dependency graph** (constructed manually, since there is no DI container):

```
Program.cs
  --> VelopackApp.Build().Run()    (installer/update hooks)
  --> App (WPF Application)

App.OnStartup():
  HttpClient (15s timeout)
  CharacterStore (DPAPI-encrypted disk store)
  EsiAuthService(HttpClient, CharacterStore) -- EVE SSO OAuth2
  EsiService(HttpClient, EsiAuthService)     -- ESI REST client
  CombatLogService()                         -- gamelog tail
  SettingsService()                          -- JSON settings
  ThemeService.Apply(...)                    -- paint saved theme
  SessionLog()                               -- AAR timeline
  AlertHub(SettingsService, SessionLog)       -- alert feed + overlay
  SystemSearchService(EsiService)            -- system autocomplete
  ZkillService(HttpClient)                   -- zKillboard client
  BattleReportService(ZkillService, EsiService)
  UpdaterService()                           -- Velopack auto-update

  ShellViewModel(all of the above)           -- root ViewModel
  MainWindow(AlertHub) { DataContext = ShellViewModel }
```

**Data flow**:

1. **EVE SSO login** --> `EsiAuthService` obtains OAuth tokens --> `CharacterStore` persists refresh tokens (DPAPI-encrypted)
2. **Fleet monitoring** --> `FleetViewModel` polls `EsiService.GetFleetMembersAsync` every 5 seconds --> resolves names/groups/types --> `ShipRoleClassifier.Classify()` assigns roles --> rebuilds hierarchy into `WingViewModel`/`SquadViewModel`/`FleetMemberViewModel`
3. **Combat alerts** --> `CombatLogService` tails EVE gamelog via FileSystemWatcher + StreamReader --> regex matches tackle/cap-out --> fires `AlertRaised` event --> `FleetViewModel` forwards to `AlertHub.Raise()` --> sound + overlay + AAR
4. **Boost tracking** --> `BoostChannelService` tails EVE Chatlogs (polled each fleet tick) --> matches charge names against `BoostChargeCatalog` --> attaches loadouts to fleet member rows
5. **Death detection** --> FleetViewModel compares per-pilot `ShipTypeId` group to Capsule group across ticks --> detects ship-to-pod transitions --> raises BoostLost/LogiChain/DpsLoss alerts, logs to AAR
6. **Intel feed** --> `IntelFeedViewModel` combines `ZkillService` kills + `IntelChannelService` chat log tailing --> `SystemSearchService` detects system names in intel reports
7. **Navigation** --> `ShellViewModel` owns `CurrentPage` (an `ObservableObject`) --> `App.xaml` DataTemplates map ViewModel types to View controls --> nav-rail commands swap `CurrentPage`
8. **Theming** --> `ThemeService.Apply()` replaces `DynamicResource` brush/color entries in `Application.Resources` --> all bindings re-resolve instantly
9. **Settings** --> `SettingsService` reads/writes `%APPDATA%\FCAT\settings.json` --> `AppSettings` model holds EVE logs path, boost/intel channel prefixes, form-up system, alert sounds, overlay state, theme, ping profiles
10. **Auto-update** --> `UpdaterService` wraps Velopack `UpdateManager` --> checks GitHub Releases on launch --> downloads in background --> offers restart pill in the top bar

**Key architectural properties**:
- No dependency injection container; all services are manually wired in `App.OnStartup()`
- Services are plain classes (no interfaces); direct concrete references throughout
- The `FleetViewModel` is the largest file at 1092 lines and contains the core fleet-monitoring logic
- The fleet session survives page navigation (kept alive on `ShellViewModel._session`) so alerts/overlay continue while browsing other pages
- The `AlertHub` lives for the entire app lifetime, not per-page
- Demo mode is a flag on `EsiService.DemoMode` that makes fleet-related calls return `DemoData` synthetic data
